integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof and standalone deterministic checks; numerical examples do not replace general proof. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Any ties can be resolved by a designated index. Unique-winner realizability is asserted only with atomless laws and strict interior F_i>G. The result builds on Ansari (2026) feasibility/construction and classical polymatroid optimization; independent priority review is not performed.
title: The exact winner-index polymatroid under prescribed marginals and a prescribed maximum
